messages:
Lisa F: Hey team — quick revrec question. We received $50,000 prepay from AcmePilot (SOW AP-2026-07) paid 2026-07-15. Original SOW = 6mo pilot July–Dec. Sales just sent a signed amendment that extends to 12 months and changes billing to monthly (retroactive to 2026-07-01). How should we adjust the deferral schedule? cc @Mike A :wave:

Mike A: Do we have the final signed amendment on file? Also was the invoice for $50k issued or was it cash-only? Need invoice vs cash for AR vs deferred rev treatment.

Lisa F: Signed PDF uploaded to Zendesk ticket Z-1229. Cash received and AE recorded as a single prepayment. Invoice INV-2026-078 was created by billing earlier today.

aeva-bot: Invoice INV-2026-078 created for AP-2026-07 amount $50,000. Payment applied. (billing-id: BIL-9832)

Juan R: If amendment is a contract modification effective 7/1 and increases the service period from 6 -> 12 months without additional performance obligations, we should prospectively amortize remaining deferred revenue over the revised performance period. Essentially, remaining unrecognized portion spreads across new remaining months.

Olivia S: Sales confirms no extra deliverables, just seat extension and longer term. Price didn't change for the pilot (still $50k). Billing frequency changes to monthly starting 9/1 for future invoices — but the $50k was prepaid and covers service back to 7/1.

Mike A: OK. Proposed steps: 1) Put $50k into Deferred Revenue (if not already). 2) Calculate revenue recognized 7/1–as-of now (we recognized nothing if it was prepaid before service). 3) Recompute amortization schedule for 12 months starting 7/1. 4) Post reclassification journal to move any amounts previously recognized incorrectly.

Sara P: Controller sign-off needed for the change in recognition method due to contract mod. Can finance Ops draft the JE and schedule? I'll queue review.

Mike A: Draft JE template below for the remaining balance as of 2026-07-31 (example numbers):

```
# Journal to reclassify/adjust deferred revenue amortization
Date: 2026-07-31
DR Deferred Revenue (liability)  $41,666.67  <-- remaining balance to amortize over 10 months (example)
CR Revenue - Product/Service      $41,666.67

# Monthly amortization starting 2026-08-01 (sample)
Aug 2026: recognize $4,166.67
Sep 2026: recognize $4,166.67
...
Jun 2027: recognize $4,166.67
```

Mike A: Note numbers above assume we recognized $8,333.33 in July already (one month) — need exact recognized to date.

Lisa F: We did not recognize any revenue yet; entry would be full 12mo amortization starting 7/1. So monthly should be $4,166.67 (50,000/12).

Juan R: That's cleaner — if no revenue recognized yet, treat amendment as prospectively setting a 12-mo service period starting 7/1 and amortize straight-line. Keep audit trail: attach amendment PDF, SOW, and billing record to the schedule.

Olivia S: One wrinkle: Sales wants to credit back part of the prepay for seats not used in month 1 and invoice monthly going forward. That would be a partial refund + new monthly invoices. If refund occurs, we need to reverse the corresponding portion of deferred revenue and reduce AR/cash accordingly.

Mike A: Agreed. If refund happens: 1) issue refund (cash), 2) reduce Deferred Revenue by refunded amount, 3) adjust monthly amortization.

Sara P: Action items: Lisa to confirm whether any revenue was recognized before payment; Mike to prepare JE + amort schedule; Juan to document accounting rationale for the contract modification; Olivia to confirm if refunds will be issued or credit notes. I'll review and sign once docs in GDrive.

Lisa F: I uploaded draft schedule + amendment + invoice to GDrive here: https://redwood.app/g/finance/AP-2026-07-revrec (permissions: finance-controller, mike). Please review by EOD tomorrow.

aeva-bot: Ticket Z-1229 updated: attachments added (amendment.pdf, INV-2026-078).

Mike A: I'll draft the JE and upload to the same folder. Will flag any tax implications if we move recognition windows.

Juan R: Also note disclosure: if this change materially affects revenue patterns we may need to call it out in quarter commentary. Not likely for $50k but flagging.

Olivia S: thx all, i'll follow up on refund question and confirm billing schedule change with AE.

Lisa F: perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Sara P: tagging for closure: after JE and schedule are uploaded I'll run the GL post and send confirmation here.
